summary: self is the object a method is running on. Inside a method, self.name is the object's field, and a plain name is a local variable or a parameter.
notes: name = name inside __init__ only assigns the parameter to itself. No field is created.
self.name = name copies the parameter into the object's field.
set_gpa(self, gpa) can use the same name for the parameter because self.gpa always means the field.
pitfall: Leaving out self. in __init__ causes AttributeError: 'BrokenStudent' object has no attribute 'name' the first time you read the field.
